# Support

- **Documentation:** the [README](../README.md) covers installation, every configuration option, the CLI and the
  migration from `self-updater` 1.x to 3.x.
- **Write a configuration:** the [configuration builder](https://self-updater.pages.dev/) checks it in your
  browser with the same validation the updater uses.
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/VectoDE/Self-Updater/issues/new/choose) with the bug template.
- **Questions and ideas:** use [Discussions](https://github.com/VectoDE/Self-Updater/discussions).
- **Security problems:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md). Never post them publicly.

This is a free tool maintained in spare time. There is no guaranteed response time and no commercial support.
